baseline_evidence_affected_closure: Validate the actual claims made by the change using the smallest sufficient checks; report any unverified surface explicitly.

operational_guidance.statement: Non-trivial/cross-session: stable workflow ID; minimal project_tool begin checkpoint if available. Immutable start facts; update only observed after-state/result/validation revisions and sourced occurrence time; Git committer time dates commits, never work start. Follow the declared current-stage schema; safely retire superseded fields. Keep required facts/unknowns in approved fields/evidence; if they cannot fit, disclose bounded delivery gaps, never drop them or add fields/files merely to mirror policies. Structured state canonical, Markdown rendered; no second history database. Use state_tool validate/render/compact/export as needed; validate refs against project root. When writable, one current handoff for unfinished work or actor/session transitions. One validation source: run ID/scope/denominator/tested state/result/pending retest; no overlapping counts or equating focused passes with full regression. Order by causal parents/revisions and persistent sequence; recorded_at=observation time. Preserve previous change; reconcile stale handoffs with current truth. Git checkpoints follow meaningful verified stages, risk or handoff boundaries under project/user policy; group related edits, inspect the diff, skip unchanged/duplicate status-only commits; never commit per tool call or push without authorization. Tracked non-trivial boundaries: project_tool finish if available, same workflow ID/observed change; unfinished partial/blocked, ID active/history intact. Reporting on: exactly one report append; off: bounded latest/previous, no ledger. Partial/blocked stages use stable checkpoint_id; identical retries add nothing, conflicts fail; completion stays unique. Reference existing current project JSON via current_state (path/SHA); status detects drift. latest_change is completed history, active last_outcome is progress; never mirror the project state. Bound scopes/metadata/evidence; no source bodies/secrets/private reasoning. Export and verify before epoch rotation; never reset sequence. Recheck binding; helper gaps remain verification gaps, never backfill historical success.

Reconstruct UPG state and unresolved artifacts as part of the existing HANDOFF_CONTINUITY closure. Optional read-only scripts/state_tool.py recover <root> --scope <file> supports repeated scopes, explicit --handoff and a registered --git-binary. Carry deltas/references into the current handoff.
